notes: Research review, not hands-on. Direct fetches of baileigh.com and retailer spec sheets were blocked (DNS); every Baileigh fact here came from WebSearch result summaries of baileigh.com pages, plus the kit fact table. Please re-verify on the live Baileigh page: (1) max bend: spec table 190 vs feature copy 200 (shown as a conflict, not resolved); (2) weight: Baileigh summary gave 290 lb and 310 lb gross, while earlier research notes list 310 lb net, so both are shown; (3) max CLR 7 in; (4) 1-year warranty; (5) die-set CLRs in the table (3/4 & 1 in @ 3 in, 1-1/4 @ 4, 1-1/2 @ 5, 1-3/4 & 2 @ 6, 2-1/2 @ 7) and 'RDB-050 only' / non-refundable tooling notes; (6) stand, handle and degree dial included comes from retailer listings (Penn Tool, Beaver Tools), not Baileigh. 'Assembly 3-4 hours' is from an older Baileigh blog post. RDB-100 facts (1.75 in OD, about 206 deg) are from Baileigh/Amazon search summaries; the .095 in wall is Amazon-only and labelled as unconfirmed. One Amazon comparison table shows a '3 inch' RDB-050 capacity; flagged in the article as inconsistent. 'No factory hydraulic kit found' is a negative search result, worded as such. Left out: price, handle length, footprint dimensions, any owner-reported durability claims (not found in a citable source).
